name: 73132 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73132 (Oklahoma City) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73132 (Oklahoma City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73132 (Oklahoma City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
